description: Use this to propose a test-USDC unit price and a quantity, or to accept the tier price. Use get_quote if you only need the list price. Required input: resource_id. Optional: unit_price_usdc, quantity from 1 to 100, and session_id. Returns an accepted offer or a counteroffer with offer_id and expiry. Does not pay.

quantity.description: Optional number of paid accesses, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 1.

resource_id.description: Required. Resource id from search_resources or get_quote.

session_id.description: Optional session id from an earlier negotiate_price call for the same resource.

unit_price_usdc.description: Optional offered unit price in test USDC, for example 0.008. Omit it to ask for this quantity's price.

name: negotiate_price
title: Negotiate price
